nodes.trans: Hello, this is Sunrise Trading. Is this the sales team?

replies.trans: Yes, this is Kim Minjun from the sales team.
Yes, it is. How can I help you?
Sorry, could you say that again?

nodes.text: 아, 네. 선라이즈 무역입니다. 영업팀 맞으시죠?
nodes.pron: a, ne. seollaijeu muyeogimnida. yeong-eoptim majeusijyo?
nodes.trans: Oh, yes. This is Sunrise Trading. This is the sales team, right?

replies.trans: Yes, that's right. This is Kim Minjun.
Yes, sorry about that. Go ahead.

nodes.trans: Is the sales team manager available?

replies.trans: Excuse me, may I ask what you're calling about?

replies.text: 죄송합니다. 팀장님은 지금 자리에 안 계십니다.
replies.pron: joesonghamnida. timjangnimeun jigeum jarie an gyesimnida.
replies.trans: I'm sorry. The manager is away from the desk right now.
I'm sorry. The manager is in a meeting right now.

nodes.trans: Oh, I see. When will the manager be back?

replies.text: 한 시간쯤 후에 오십니다. 메모 남겨 드릴까요?
replies.pron: han sigan-jjeum hue osimnida. memo namgyeo deurilkkayo?
replies.trans: In about an hour. Shall I take a message?
This afternoon. Can I help you instead?

nodes.text: 네, 부탁드립니다. 선라이즈 무역으로 전화 좀 달라고 전해 주세요.
nodes.pron: ne, butakdeurimnida. seollaijeu muyeogeuro jeonhwa jom dallago jeonhae juseyo.
nodes.trans: Yes, please. Please ask the manager to call Sunrise Trading back.

replies.text: 네, 알겠습니다. 연락처는 팀장님이 알고 계시죠?
replies.pron: ne, algetseumnida. yeollakcheoneun timjangnimi algo gyesijyo?
replies.trans: Sure. The manager has your number, right?
Sure. May I ask what it's about?

nodes.text: 네, 알고 계실 거예요. 새 견적서 건입니다.
nodes.pron: ne, algo gyesil geoyeyo. sae gyeonjeokseo geonimnida.
nodes.trans: Yes, the manager should have it. It's about the new quote.

replies.trans: Understood. I'll pass that on.

replies.text: 견적서는 제가 바로 보내 드릴 수 있습니다.
replies.pron: gyeonjeokseoneun jega baro bonae deuril su itseumnida.
replies.trans: I can send you the quote right away myself.

nodes.text: 저희 주문 건 수정 견적서가 필요해서요.
nodes.pron: jeohui jumun geon sujeong gyeonjeokseoga piryohaeseoyo.
nodes.trans: We need the revised quote for our order.

replies.text: 그건 제가 보내 드릴 수 있습니다.
replies.pron: geugeon jega bonae deuril su itseumnida.
replies.trans: I can send that to you.
Which product is the quote for?
I'll ask the manager to call you back.

nodes.trans: The office chairs. We ordered them last week.

replies.trans: I see. When do you need it by?
Understood. I'll send it to you.
By Friday. Understood.

replies.text: 금요일은 좀 어려울 것 같은데, 월요일도 괜찮으세요?
replies.pron: geumyoireun jom eoryeoul geot gateunde, woryoildo gwaenchaneuseyo?
replies.trans: Friday might be a bit difficult. Would Monday be okay?

nodes.text: 월요일 오전이면 괜찮습니다. 그보다 늦으면 안 됩니다.
nodes.pron: woryoil ojeonimyeon gwaenchanseumnida. geuboda neujeumyeon an doemnida.
nodes.trans: Monday morning is fine. But it can't be any later than that.

replies.trans: Monday morning. Understood.
Thank you for understanding.

nodes.trans: Thank you. Could you send it by email?

replies.trans: Sure. What is your email address?

replies.text: 네. 지난번 주소로 보내 드리면 될까요?
replies.pron: ne. jinanbeon jusoro bonae deurimyeon doelkkayo?
replies.trans: Sure. Should I send it to the same address as last time?

nodes.trans: It's sales at sunrise dot com.

replies.trans: Sales at sunrise dot com, is that right?

replies.text: 다시 확인하겠습니다. 세일즈 골뱅이 선라이즈 닷컴이요?
replies.pron: dasi hwaginhagetseumnida. seiljeu golbaeng-i seollaijeu datkeomiyo?
replies.trans: Let me read that back. Sales at sunrise dot com?
I'll send it this afternoon.
I'll check with the manager and get back to you.
Understood. I'll send it this afternoon.

replies.text: 알겠습니다. 먼저 팀장님께 확인하고 다시 연락드리겠습니다.
replies.pron: algetseumnida. meonjeo timjangnimkke hwaginhago dasi yeollakdeurigetseumnida.
replies.trans: Understood. I'll check with the manager first and get back to you.

nodes.trans: Thank you. I'll leave it with you, then. Goodbye.
All right, I'll wait to hear from you. Thank you.
